summary.prose: Finishes Story s3 by implementing the two remaining Tasks (t5: the sc3 entry-point body handleSecurityReviewStep, t6: wiring it as the insrc_security_review_step daemon IPC method + MCP tool) on top of the now-genuinely-built t1-t4. t1-t4 are carried forward with their real, already-verified acceptance checks and test names restored from git history after an earlier re-plan incorrectly replaced them with a false 'already built' placeholder.

tasks.title: Implement deriveReceiptIdentity, verifyContentIdentityMatch, and s3's new error/report types
tasks.summary: Built and passed (commit 78f2e8441). Adds ContentIdentityMismatchError and SecurityModelUnavailableError, the in-memory SecurityReviewReport interface, deriveReceiptIdentity(contentIdentity), and verifyContentIdentityMatch(repoPath, targets, advisoryEvidence).
acceptanceChecks: deriveReceiptIdentity(contentIdentity) returns {epicHash, storyId:'s1'} where epicHash is exactly 16 lowercase hex characters derived deterministically from contentIdentity; the SAME contentIdentity always re-derives the identical pair, a different one derives a different pair
the derived identity round-trips through a REAL persistVerificationReceipt + readReceiptRecord call without being rejected by the storage layer's own id-shape checks
verifyContentIdentityMatch resolves silently when computeContentIdentity(repoPath, targets) === advisoryEvidence.contentIdentity and advisoryEvidence.contentStable is true
verifyContentIdentityMatch throws ContentIdentityMismatchError when the recomputed identity does not match advisoryEvidence.contentIdentity
verifyContentIdentityMatch throws ContentIdentityMismatchError when contentStable is false even though the identity strings match

tests.name: deriveReceiptIdentity: same contentIdentity re-derives the identical pair; a different identity derives a different pair
deriveReceiptIdentity's output round-trips through a REAL persistVerificationReceipt + readReceiptRecord call without being rejected by the storage layer
verifyContentIdentityMatch: resolves on a match with contentStable:true; throws on identity mismatch; throws on contentStable:false even when identity matches

tasks.title: Implement assembleSecurityReport
acceptanceChecks: confirmed advisoryEvidence.matches map to dependency-advisory SecurityFindings with checkId:'dependency-advisory' and NO receiptId set
round-1 code findings carry receiptId === receipts.round1.id; round-2 code findings carry receiptId === receipts.round2.id
unresolvedDependencies and unavailableSources pass through verbatim onto the returned SecurityReviewReport
empty advisoryEvidence.matches and empty codeFindings together produce an empty findings array, never an error
effectiveModel on the returned report equals modelSelection exactly as passed in, even when it differs from the repo's currently-configured tier default

tests.name: assembleSecurityReport: confirmed matches map to dependency-advisory SecurityFindings with checkId:'dependency-advisory'; unresolvedDependencies/unavailableSources pass through verbatim; empty inputs produce an empty findings array
assembleSecurityReport leaves receiptId unset on every dependency-advisory finding, and sets it only on the code findings produced by the matching round

tasks.title: Implement runSecurityReview
acceptanceChecks: a targets.entries path resolving outside repoPath throws synchronously before computeContentIdentity, any CLI dispatch, or any receipt persistence is attempted

the entire call body runs under a step context bound to {cwd:repoPath, envRepo:repoPath} while preserving an outer connectionExecution exactly as src/shared/step-context.ts's own runInStepContext spread pattern requires -- a case with a REAL bound connectionExecution set beforehand succeeds, not just the unbound ambient-cwd case
refuses before any round dispatches when modelSelection.status is 'unavailable', throwing SecurityModelUnavailableError with the blockerReason, and the fake CLI session is never called
refuses before any round dispatches when the pre-flight verifyContentIdentityMatch fails, and no receipt is persisted

persists exactly ONE VerificationReceipt per round (round1, round2), each 'pass' on a clean run; a round's own execution failure persists only that round's 'fail' receipt and never dispatches a later round

reverifies contentIdentity immediately before round 2 and immediately before final persistence; a content change injected between round 1 and round 2 in a test fixture is caught and aborts with ContentIdentityMismatchError, with round 1's receipt already durably persisted as 'pass'

two sequential calls with the SAME reviewId -- the first failing a round, the second succeeding -- persist TWO distinct receipts per round slot (different attemptId), both independently readable via readReceiptRecord; the first attempt's 'fail' receipt is never overwritten
run with repoPath=B while the test harness's own ambient cwd is A: every nested helper (checkpoint, reconciliation, report render, cleanup) reads/writes under B only, never A

epicHash/storyId supplied on the call are threaded directly into persistVerificationReceipt's ident with standalone left unset; when omitted, deriveReceiptIdentity's output is used with standalone:true
on success both round receipts exist and finalizeAndCleanup has run; on a pre-flight refusal, neither a receipt nor a checkpoint exists

runSecurityReview invoked from inside an ALREADY-BOUND step context (a real connectionExecution set via runInStepContext in the test) succeeds
runSecurityReview refuses before any round dispatches on modelSelection.status:'unavailable', verified via the fake CLI session never being called
runSecurityReview refuses before any round dispatches on a contentIdentity mismatch
runSecurityReview persists ONE VerificationReceipt per round (round1, round2), each with the correct result; a round-1 failure persists only round1's fail receipt and never dispatches round 2

runSecurityReview reverifies contentIdentity before round 2 and before finalization; a repository edit injected between round 1 and round 2 is caught and aborts with ContentIdentityMismatchError, with round1's receipt already durably persisted as 'pass' from before the edit

SecurityReviewReport.effectiveModel matches the modelSelection actually passed in, in a case where it differs from the repo's currently-configured tier default

two sequential runSecurityReview calls with the SAME reviewId -- the first failing a round, the second succeeding -- persist TWO distinct receipts per round slot (different attemptId); the first attempt's 'fail' receipt is never overwritten

tasks.title: Implement handleSecurityReviewStep + SecurityReviewStepRequest/Response types
tasks.summary: The sc3 entry-point body: on a fresh phase:'start' request, checks resolveRepoLastIndexedAt(repoPath) against the request's targets and returns {next:'confirm_wait', state, guidance} when stale and the caller has not said proceed; otherwise (or on a resumed call) resolves s1's SecurityModelSelection (resolveSecurityModel) and s2's SecurityAdvisoryEvidence (collectDependencyAdvisories) itself, then calls t4's runSecurityReview and returns {next:'done', report, markdown}.
acceptanceChecks: a fresh request against a repo with a FRESH index reaches {next:'done'} directly, never confirm_wait
a fresh request against a repo with a STALE index returns {next:'confirm_wait', state, guidance} without running resolveSecurityModel, collectDependencyAdvisories, or any round
a resumed call ({phase:'start', state, proceed:true}) waits for the index before running the review end-to-end to done
a resumed call ({phase:'start', state, proceed:false}) runs the review against the index as-is (a degraded run) and still reaches done with a fully populated report
epicHash/storyId supplied on the ORIGINAL request are passed straight through into runSecurityReview's opts unchanged, never re-derived or second-guessed here
ContentIdentityMismatchError and SecurityModelUnavailableError from runSecurityReview propagate out of handleSecurityReviewStep unchanged

tests.name: handleSecurityReviewStep: a stale-index fresh request returns confirm_wait with a state token, never runs a round; a resumed call with proceed:true or proceed:false both reach done; epicHash/storyId supplied on the request are threaded into the persisted receipt unchanged, while an omitted pair is derived via deriveReceiptIdentity with standalone:true

the daemon's step-call dispatch recognizes the new tool id the same way it already recognizes insrc_code_review_step/insrc_review_step for bound-connection-execution purposes

calling the registered tool end-to-end (fresh request, fresh index) returns a next:'done' response with a real report and markdown, proving the registration -> handler wiring is live, not just type-checked
